_comment: Routine action kind `script` (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3, §4.2). Runs in mChatAIShell (placement from harness/routines/policy.json), never inside the sandboxed app. params is a JSON-Schema subset validated by the propose verb and the detail form (R5/R8) and by scripts/check_routine_content.py for templates. The shell re-checks every fire: signed lease, realpath(cwd) under the allowed roots, interpreter on the allowlist, script hash unchanged (a changed script is refused: scriptChanged).
summary: Run a script from this conversation's folder on a schedule.
help: The script runs in mChatAIShell, so it keeps running while mChatAI+ is closed. It must live inside the conversation's folder or a folder you picked. The script is fingerprinted when you approve the routine: if it changes, the routine stops and asks you to review the change. The runner passes MCHATAI_ROUTINE_ID, MCHATAI_ROUTINE_RUN_ID, MCHATAI_ROUTINE_OUTPUT_DIR and MCHATAI_WORKBENCH_SESSION. A script can report back by writing $MCHATAI_ROUTINE_OUTPUT_DIR/result.json as {"summary", "status": "ok|warning|error", "outputs": [{"path", "title", "kind"}]}; otherwise the last stdout line (if it is JSON), then the exit code and the collected files are used.

cwd.title: Folder
cwd.description: Relative to the owning conversation's folder, or an absolute folder you picked. Must resolve (symlinks followed) inside an allowed root.

entry.title: Script file
entry.description: Path of the script inside the folder.

interpreter.title: Interpreter
interpreter.description: Found through your login shell's PATH when the schedule is handed to mChatAIShell. Never falls back to /usr/bin/python3.

env.title: Environment
env.description: Extra environment variables. Only names on this file's envAllowlist are passed; the list is empty in v1.
